lines.text: A ninety nine on Metacritic, and players are posting flying cars.
Reviewers mostly noticed pedestrians walking into walls, and clothes popping in for a second.
Players are posting clips of cars flying, characters vanishing, and one falling through a prison floor.
A ship even slid sideways across the water.
Some people compare it to Cyberpunk's launch.
But PC Guide says early reports don't show most players are affected.
So it's loud online, but far from Cyberpunk, going by early reports.
